messages:
maya: Quick one for month-close: noticed a $72k vendor credit posted to deferred revenue as a multi-month schedule but it should've been a one-time contra-expense (vendor rebate). Came in via BILLPAY export.

sam: Oof. Which vendor and invoice? Any GL refs?

maya: Vendor=CloudPartner Inc, bill_id=CP-99821, ext_ref=VP-2026-11. GL posted to 2100-DeferredRevenue with rev_schedule=ratable_3mo. Posted by `billing-inbound` job on 2026-11-30 21:04 UTC.

jon: That explains the weird revrec this month. We only expected a single period reduction to COGS, not a deferral. Could be mapping on vendor type. We recently added `rebate_allowed=true` to vendor profile on 11/25.

acct-bot: Automated alert: mismatch detected between expected vendor accounting treatment and posted schedule. Created ticket FIN-4432.

sam: Steps: (1) pull the vendor bill payload, (2) check vendor mapping table `vendor_accounting`, (3) reverse the deferral JE and post one-time contra expense JE dated 11/30. Maya can you confirm tax/withholding impact?

maya: Confirmed: vendor rebate, no tax withholding. Also need to adjust revenue schedules for any customer invoices that used that rebate as a credit. I see one AR credit memo applied to CUST-776 (accounting applied it as credit against future invoices).

jon: SQL to find scope I ran: `select bill_id, amount, gl_account, rev_schedule, applied_to from vendor_bills where bill_date >= '2026-11-01' and vendor = 'CloudPartner Inc';` Results: CP-99821 amount= -72000 gl_account=2100 rev_schedule=ratable_3mo applied_to='CUST-776-creditmemo-889'.

sam: Good catch. Maya please draft reversing JE: DR 2100 DeferredRevenue 72000 / CR 4000 VendorPayable 72000 to unwind. Then post DR 6000 ContraCOGS 72000 / CR 4000 VendorPayable 72000 for the correct treatment. We'll need both so the payable clears.

maya: I'll draft the two entries and upload to NetSuite. Tagging revenue-ops for guidance on recognition cutover.

revenue-ops: Quick note: because the original posting date is 11/30 we should keep the reversal and reclassification in November close period to avoid cut/paste of revenue. If JE posts in Dec, we need disclosure. Keep original dates.

acct-bot: FIN-4432 updated: status=investigating assignee=maya.

jon: Also flag any automated mappings causing vendor types with `rebate_allowed=true` to default to ratable schedule. We should add a guard: if vendor_bill.type == 'rebate' then rev_schedule=one_time.

sam: Agreed. I'll open a code change and require a staging billing-run with smoke tests that assert vendor rebates are not split across schedules.

maya: Posted reversing JE in NetSuite (draft) with id=JE-77821, attached supporting vendor invoice and credit memo. Will post final after review.

revenue-ops: Reviewed supporting docs. Approve posting in Nov. Please include memo referencing FIN-4432.

maya: Posted both JEs (JE-77821 reverse & JE-77822 reclass). NetSuite status=posted. Updated FIN-4432 -> resolved.

acct-bot: FIN-4432 updated: status=resolved resolution="reclass vendor rebate from deferred rev -> contra-COGS, JEs JE-77821/JE-77822".

sam: Thanks team. Add remediation: add unit test for vendor mapping, and add a month-close checklist item to scan for vendor bill rev_schedule != expected by vendor type.

maya: Will add to close checklist and notify AP to flag rebates in their upload template. Closing thread.
